snippet.title: What fits into 1 day of Gamedev?  (Sword Hero - Mini Devlog 1)
snippet.description:
Hey hey guys! Today I've made a bit longer video about my progress, as I've had a bit more time.

Here's what fits into one day of gamedev!

Also, follow Sword Hero on Kickstarter, join the Discord - And let me know what you think!

https://www.swordherogame.com/
